resources.string: Ask about the documents on your PC from your phone.
Go to Settings > Phone, turn it on and choose \"Show QR code\".
Scan the code with this phone. Phone and PC must be on the same Wi-Fi.
How much do I have to pay, and by when?
Your documents and the AI model stay on your PC. The phone connects over your home network, encrypted, and only shows the answers.
Point the camera at the QR code on your PC\'s screen.
StarkLLM needs the camera only to read the QR code. Nothing is recorded.
This is not a StarkLLM pairing code.
StarkLLM will connect to this PC on your home network (%1$s). Only continue if the code is shown on your own PC.
The PC cannot be reached. Is it on, is StarkLLM running, and are the phone and the PC on the same Wi-Fi?
The device that answered is not the paired PC (its certificate differs). Nothing was sent. Pair again with a new QR code if StarkLLM was reinstalled on the PC.
This code has expired or was already used. Show a new QR code on the PC.
The PC did not accept the code. Show a new QR code on the PC.
Ten phones are paired with this PC already. Remove one on the PC first (Settings > Phone).
This phone is no longer paired with the PC. Pair it again.
StarkLLM on the PC is fully offline, so it does not accept the phone right now.
StarkLLM on the PC could not do this. Try again in a moment.
StarkLLM on this PC has several accounts. Signing in from the phone comes in a later version.
No workspaces yet. Create one in StarkLLM on your PC.
No chats in this workspace yet.
Delete \"%1$s\" on the PC as well? This cannot be undone.
Ask anything about the documents in this workspace.
StarkLLM did not find these quoted words in the documents. Check them before you rely on them:
To use StarkLLM again you need a new QR code from the PC. Also remove this phone on the PC under Settings > Phone.
The PC does not allow this for this phone. You can change it on the PC under Settings > Phone.
Pair this phone with your PC first.
What would you like to know about your documents?
The PC is writing down what you said…
Goes into the workspace \"%1$s\" on your PC; the PC reads it, also the text in photos.
Also search the knowledge base folders
Sent to \"%1$s\". The PC is reading it now.
Nothing was understood. Hold the button while you speak.
The backup on the PC is done and tested.
The backup on the PC did not work. Look at Settings > Backup on the PC.
StarkLLM on the PC is now fully offline. The phone can reach it again when you switch it back on the PC.
StarkLLM on the PC reads these dates from your letters by fixed rules; no AI model guesses them. Check the letter before you rely on a date.
On: documents and chats are encrypted on the PC
Ask, send and manage this PC
StarkLLM on the PC stops every connection, also to this phone. To use the phone again, switch it back on the PC (Settings > Privacy & network).
To start a backup or switch StarkLLM offline from this phone, allow \"manage\" for it on the PC under Settings > Phone.
Ask for the fingerprint, face or PIN when the app opens
Set up a screen lock on the phone first
When the phone is at home, it checks the PC every few hours. No cloud service.
Add the tile \"Ask StarkLLM\" to Quick Settings, and the widget \"StarkLLM deadlines\" to the home screen. Share PDFs and photos from other apps to StarkLLM.
Free and open source. Your documents stay on your PC.
The next deadlines from your letters
Another answer is still coming in. Ask again in a moment.
